body.name: Attaining-estimator handle
body.construction: Construct \(\widehat V_\star\) by sample splitting for localization, a smooth-region bias correction, and on each nonsmooth patient group the finite observed-cell lift \(U_{Q_L}\) with coefficient table indexed by \(\mathcal A_{2K,L}\) and certified by \(\mathfrak J(d,K,\lambda,L)\); combine the group contributions with empirical weights and clip to \([0,1]\). Once the tables are generated, dense evaluation on the sample uses at most \(C_1[n+d\{K L^2+L M_{2K,L}\}]\) arithmetic operations and \(C_1d\{K L+M_{2K,L}\}\) stored scalars. Exact semialgebraic generation of the finite primal coefficient tables and this evaluation give total statistical computability; because \(M_{2K,L}=\binom{2K+L}{L}\), no polynomial-time claim in \((n,d,K)\) is made.
